L9·N7492unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially a digit/number detector operating in the negative direction — it is driven strongly negative by numerals inside quantities, years, model names and citation page numbers ("4"/"0" in 400 or 40K, "9" in 1996, "):" after a volume number), while its near-zero "max" activations are just weak, unremarkable firings on modifier/head words inside noun phrases ("put" option, "wicked" problem, "fast" charging, TOTP "secret").
